identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Pembrolizumab Versus Docetaxel in Participants Previously Treated for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (MK-3475-033/KEYNOTE-033)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multinational, Multicenter, Phase III, Randomized Open-label Trial of Pembrolizumab Versus Docetaxel in Previously Treated Subjects With Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Pembrolizumab
armGroups.description: Participants with NSCLC receive pembrolizumab 2 mg/kg intravenously (IV) over 30 minutes every 3 weeks (Q3W) for up to 35 doses (approximately 24 months).

armGroups.label: Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Participants with NSCLC receive Docetaxel 75 mg/m\^2 IV over 1 hour Q3W until disease progression, toxicity, investigator's decision to discontinue, or consent withdrawal.

interventions.name: Pembrolizumab
interventions.description: Pembrolizumab administered IV at 2 mg/kg on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for up to 35 doses (approximately 24 months).

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: Docetaxel administered IV at 75 mg/m\^2 on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle as per the approved product label.
